sar.narrative: Customer C12641, holder of card C12641-K2, is the subject of this report due to suspicious online activity detected by a monitoring alert for structuring. Between 2016-11-29 19:00 and 2016-11-29 19:36, four online purchases totaling $1,922.43 were executed on the card via device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1440x900' in a band burst of under 90 minutes. Specifically, the transactions were $463.86 (transaction 3497982 at 19:00), $497.63 (transaction 3498004 at 19:07), $476.46 (transaction 3498051 at 19:20), and $484.48 (transaction 3498092 at 19:36). Each amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold, and the $476.46 transaction significantly exceeded the card's 95th percentile of $170.04 and median of $105.91. Furthermore, product code C was never used on this card before, and eight of the eight most similar closed cases—including CC-0164, CC-4943, CC-1476, and CC-2910—were confirmed fraud. A case-memory model score of 0.352 indicated that the transaction's feature profile, which includes Vesta's unnamed V/C/D/M/id features, strongly resembles transactions in confirmed-fraud closed cases from July to October, alongside a bank risk score of 0.23. The verdict for this activity is fraud with an undocumented pattern resulting in an exposure of $1,922.43. In response to these findings, the bank's automated systems executed a case creation and escalated the matter to an analyst, while recommending the execution of a card block (L1) and the filing of this report (L2).
